notes: Spanish is part of ELA on Tuesday and Thursday.
Physical Sciences follows the family label and includes biology, anatomy, physiology, chemistry, physics, Earth science, and astronomy.
Life Sciences follows the family label and includes psychology, development, sociology, philosophy, and unbiased comparative religion.
Friday offers weekly checks or module-end exams, projects, field trips, independent study, and catch-up. Select the needed activities; there are no four new core lessons on Friday.
The original first week, school-year dates, and breaks are preserved.
Introductory breadth is scheduled; this does not assert exhaustive subject mastery or independent state-standards certification.
Books labeled with a different publisher grade are adapted reference selections, not represented as exact grade-level editions.
